description.value: The caster emulates Phoenix’s ability to manifest a sacred flame from a foe, dealing damage and draining health. The target takes 6d6 points of (half fire/holy) damage and the caster is healed for that much. A successful Fortitude reduces the damage by half and the caster does not gain any hit points. Learned From Phoenix, Phoenix Spawn, Leanan, Red Dragon Family, and Ruby
